description.value:
From Cream · Price: you can't see or hear while inside the void, and you can only move in straight lines.

Theme Space

  • 1: 2 actions: you and your stand vanish into a sphere; you're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{undetected} and can't be targeted, but you're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{blinded} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{deafened}. 1 action: move up to your Speed in a straight line; creatures and objects you pass through take @Damage[(1+floor((@actor.level - 1)/4))d6[force]] damage (@Check[reflex|against:stand|basic]{basic Reflex}), once per creature per turn. Your stand can become the void on its own instead, carrying it through creatures within its range while you stay outside. Leaving takes 1 action, and the void ends after 1 minute.
  • 5: Surge: passing through deals @Damage[(2*ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[force]] damage instead.
  • 9: A creature that fails its save against the void loses a piece of itself: it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{drained 1}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{drained 2} on a critical failure.
  • 13: You can peek out for 1 action to see for an instant without leaving the void.
  • 17: Moving inside the void costs 1 action for double your Speed.

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
